meta.source: Meta Catalog search (100 models frozen at the 10:52 PT refresh scope, 1987 raw listings, 2026-11-06 PM) + browser page checks for price moves (see sources_note). SUPERSEDES the 2026-11-06 morning 28-model snapshot (same file): the morning file is replaced, not kept alongside, because the refresh scope grew to 100 models and the morning file's 28 models are a subset.
meta.sources_note: Scope frozen at 100 models for this refresh (92 swept at run start + 8 more swept after the 2026-11-06 expansion update to 100). Expansion batches 16+ (Anker/JBL/Razer/Corsair/Dell/HP/Lenovo/ASUS, now 140 models) have their own batch snapshots and join the consolidated daily snapshot tomorrow. Meta Catalog raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_*_2026-11-06.json (gitignored). URLs cleaned of fbclid/utm/tracking params (variant-defining params kept). Stock not asserted by snapshot; delivered cost/tax not verified, no checkout started. Browser-verified carried quotes (CARRIED_QUOTES in the refresh builder): MacBook Pro 14 M6 Apple/Best Buy $1,999 (launch-day check, AM); Kindle Best Buy $199.99 (bestbuy.com JSON-LD, PM); MX Vertical Dell $119.99 and Logitech $99.99 (merchant pages, PM). Best Buy feed rows repeatedly proved to be marketplace sellers' prices (PS5 Digital $729 = RYTEK, Quest 3S $422.82 = EZ Tech, Xbox controller $89.25 = IPC-STORE, Kindle $229.99 = marketplace range top) — all excluded via KNOWN_BAD; Best Buy's own price is used only when the page shows Best Buy itself as the seller. Samsung Buds4's $135 feed row was a Panama shop (shop.samsung.com/latin/pa/) — excluded by a new URL-path non-US check; the US price is $179.99. WH-CH720N BJ's $99.99 is UNVERIFIED (BJ's shows 'Member Only Price — Sign in to see price'; item in stock, BJ's is the seller). Keychron Q1 $69.99 CONFIRMED on keychron.com (sale from $169.99). MX Master 4 Graphite retailer hunt (Walmart): blocked — walmart.com/search returned a bot-check page; no workaround attempted; still only Logitech direct $119.99. Next retailer: Target. Apple patrol (first in rotation): 9 of 11 zero-quote Apple models have apple.com rows for other configs in the feed; iPad A16 and MacBook Neo have no Apple feed rows but are listed on apple.com (iPad A16 US $449; MacBook Neo Blush 256GB listed, US $699 after the 2026-06-25 increase). No Apple model is delisted; zero quotes are feed gaps. M6 Pro UPC still unpublished; the one-off 2026-11-07 10:00 PT UPC check cron stands (not duplicated here). Kindle pin UNCHANGED (B0CFPL6CFY); Best Buy's own page lists Model B0CFPJYX7P, noted as further evidence for the pending user decision, no change made.
excluded_traps: Price moves over $5, verified vs unverified: Keychron Q1 Keychron $89.99 -> $69.99 CONFIRMED (keychron.com sale). WH-CH720N BJ's $179.99 -> $99.99 UNVERIFIED (BJ's member-only price, sign-in required; item in stock). Kindle Best Buy $229.99 feed row REJECTED (marketplace range top; Best Buy own price $199.99 carried). PS5 Digital Best Buy $729 REJECTED (RYTEK marketplace; Best Buy own listing out of stock). MX Vertical Dell $89.99 and Logitech $84.99 feed rows REJECTED (pages show $119.99 and $99.99). Quest 3S Best Buy $422.82 REJECTED (EZ Tech marketplace). Xbox controller Best Buy $89.25 REJECTED (IPC-STORE marketplace). Samsung Buds4 $135 REJECTED (Panama shop). Trivial moves (<$5, not rechecked): Switch 2 ShopMyExchange $499.99 -> $499.00, DualSense Edge Abt $199.99 -> $199.00, WH-1000XM4C Best Buy $299.99 -> $298.00.
PS5 Digital: zero seller-direct quotes this round — Best Buy own listing out of stock (only RYTEK marketplace $729, excluded) and Sam's Club feed row absent. Read as a stock gap, not a delisting.

18 models have ZERO qualifying rows in this round — read as catalog-feed gaps, not delistings: Anker Prime 100W (only a 200W row, a charger+cable bundle, and a Panama seller); iMac M6 (only a 12-core NFM row, pinned is 10-core); iPad A16 / Air 11 / Air 13 / mini / Pro 11 / Pro 13 (Apple rows are other configs — MPN check); MacBook Air 13/15 M5 (Apple rows are other part numbers); MacBook Neo (no Apple feed rows; listed on apple.com at $699); Mac Studio (Apple $5,499 row is a higher config; Abt $2,799 is 1TB vs pinned 512GB); Bose QC Earbuds (Bose direct rows carry no color); Keychron K8 HE / K8 hot-swappable (Keychron rows carry no color/switch); N64 controller (Nintendo row carries no color); Switch Pro Controller (Dell row carries no color); Pulse headset white (only Pulse Elite rows returned); PS5 Digital (see above).

Builder fixes applied in this refresh (documented in BUILD_LOG 063): 'joy con' removed from the global exclusion list (the Switch console's own title names Joy-Con — restores Nintendo Switch Neon $339.99); 'core' added as a config unit with a per-unit any-match rule (a title stating one of two required core counts is not a conflict — restores MacBook Pro 14 ProLED XDR NFM $2,899); MPN-in-URL check skipped for watches (the Watch MPN encodes only the band — restores Watch SE 3 Apple $249); 'w' (watts) added as a config unit (rejects the Anker 200W row); charger+cable 'and' titles rejected as bundles; Joy-Con pairs must name both sides in the title (rejects the single (L) $54.99 row); keyboard switch/layout exclusions (MX Mechanical Mini/Clicky/Linear, G915 X Clicky/GL Blue/TKL/Core, PRO X TKL Rapid/Linear/Core/INT'L); duplicate magic-mouse MODEL_MATCH entry removed; 'combo' added to traps; ankerpanama.com, fattalonline.com, bkstr.com (incl. campus subdomains) blocked; merchant canonicalization completed (Logitech G, Lenovo US, JustPressPlay, RC Willey, Electronic Express, Impulse Cameras, CDW, PlayStation Direct, MacExperience, MelroseMac, Walt's, HSN, Silarius, Boolchand, Golf+ VR, Virtuix, Quill, Antonline).

Non-US / wrong-variant rows excluded throughout (DECISIONS 021): Newegg (marketplace rows indistinguishable from Newegg-sold), Ayoub (Lebanon), iCuracao, syscom/ar-lb, MEA/LatAm suffixes, Panama Samsung shop, bundles, open-box/renewed/refurbished, education/campus-store pricing, rental (Rent-A-Center/Aarons), B2B distributor, corporate-gift and trade-in sellers, accessories/cases/skins, and protection-plan suffix rows kept only where the price is the product's own (Datavision XM6, BuyDig CH720N flagged).

New merchants to watch (first appearance as a model's only or cheapest quote): Silarius (Buds3 FE $169.99, only quote — MPN in title matches exactly); Quill (G Pro X Superlight 2 DEX $214.99, only quote vs prior $159.99); MelroseMac (Studio Display XDR $2,899 vs $3,299 list); Golf+ VR (Quest 3 512GB $599.99); Smith's Food and Drug (Pulse Elite $149.99). None verified by a page check this run.

Kindle: entry UNCHANGED (still pinned B0CFPL6CFY, user undecided). Best Buy own price $199.99 carried (see above). Target $199.99 is new. NFM $196.99 still the low. RC Willey excluded (URL carries B0CFPJYX7P).
MX Master 4 Graphite: still only Logitech direct $119.99. Walmart hunt blocked (bot-check, no workaround). Best Buy, B&H, Adorama already ruled out; Target next.
Switch 2: Nintendo $499.99 keeps (the earlier GONE was a dedupe bug — a $3.99 game row shadowed the merchant; fixed by per-row band filtering). Dell $449.99 stays KNOWN_BAD.
Switch OLED White: US price $399.99 (post-August 2025 increase). Sam's Club $399 NEW; Best Buy $411.38 NEW is above list and unflagged — treat as unverified.

GONE characterization: 164 rows GONE vs the prior baseline (morning + batch 1–15 snapshots). Most are feed churn — the feed returns a different sample each round (e.g. all 6 MDR-7506, all 5 MDR-MV1/M1, all 5 Buds3 FE prior quotes absent). A minority are rule-driven: host-blocked (Newegg, bkstr campus), variant-filtered (keyboard switch/layout rows, Anker 200W/bundle, Joy-Con single), or price-band drops (scalpers, games, accessories). No model was removed from the catalog; zero-quote models are feed gaps.
